channel.title: Kettlebell Movement a Day
channel.description: One kettlebell movement a day with a short coaching cue.

item.title: Sumo Deadlift
item.description:
Take a wide stance, toes turned out, and push your knees out as you pull.

Category: hinge  |  Level: beginner

item.title: Deadlift
item.description:
Push your hips back, keep the kettlebell close, and stand up by driving through your heels.

Category: hinge  |  Level: beginner
